description: Source code implementing a text box dialog component for a Linux kernel configuration interface, including functions for displaying, scrolling, and rendering text within a window.

methods.name: back_lines
methods.description: Navigate backwards 'n' lines in the text buffer.

methods.name: get_line
methods.description: Retrieve the current line of text from the buffer.

methods.name: print_line
methods.description: Render a line of text in the window, with horizontal scrolling.

methods.name: print_page
methods.description: Render a page of text lines in the window.

methods.name: print_position
methods.description: Display the current scroll position as a percentage.

methods.name: refresh_text_box
methods.description: Update the window content with current text and position.

methods.name: dialog_textbox
methods.description: Display a scrollable text box dialog with user interaction.
